description.en: Israeli-held Golan west of the 10 June 1967 ceasefire line, adjusted by the 31 May 1974 separation-of-forces agreement (UN buffer zone).

sources.quote: the Israeli-Syrian armistice line of June 10, 1967, which was later modified by the separation of forces agreement of May 31, 1974.
these farmlands lie in an area occupied by Israel since 1967

notes.en: During the October 1973 war Israel temporarily advanced beyond the Golan into Syria (Britannica Arab-Israeli wars); not modelled.
